title: Cost to Get Card Graded (2026)
verdict: The cost to get one card graded ranges from $14.95 at Beckett's slowest tier to $18 at AGS and $32.99 at PSA's Value tier, before shipping.

Most graders now charge between $10 and $50 a card on their entry tiers, and the spread comes from speed, minimums and whether the fee rises with the card's value. AGS sits at the low end with no minimum and no value upcharge.

ranking.lacks: Bulk pricing needs 30 cards. CGC's needs 10.
ranking.note: $18 flat with no minimum, or $15 a card from 30 TCG cards. Code AGSNEW20 takes 20% off a first order, and nothing is charged until the cards are graded.

ranking.lacks: Slow at the cheap tier. The fast tiers cost $80 to $125.

ranking.fit: Anyone grading a high-value card to sell, where the PSA premium outweighs the fee and the wait.

why: There is no value upcharge. A $20 card and a $20,000 card cost the same $18 to grade at AGS, and bulk orders of 30 or more start at $15. Subgrades and the report are included, where Beckett charges $3 more for subgrades at its Base tier.
Thirty cards gets you the bulk rate. The report, the subgrades and the slab are the same as on a single-card order, so a shop can list every card with its scan attached.

You see why the card got its grade. AGS issues eight subgrades, four for the front and four for the back, plus a defect list and a 3D heightmap. Most graders hand back one number. A buyer who can open the report has less to argue about.

faq.q: What does it cost to get one card graded?
faq.a: $18 at AGS with no minimum. $14.95 at Beckett's Base tier if you can wait 45 business days or more. $32.99 at PSA's Value tier. CGC's $10 bulk price needs 10 cards.

faq.q: Is it worth grading a low-value card?
faq.a: Only if grading lifts the price by more than the fee plus shipping, or if you want the card protected and documented. At $10 to $18 a card the math works on far more cards than at $50.

faq.q: Which card grader has the lowest listed price?
faq.a: As of November 18, 2026, GMA is lowest at $12 a card with a 25-card minimum, or $9 at 100 cards. CGC's bulk tier is $10 with a 10-card minimum on cards worth up to $500. Beckett's Base tier is $14.95, and ISA and AGS bulk are $15.

faq.q: How much does AGS charge to grade a card?
faq.a: $18 per card at the standard rate, whatever the card is worth. Bulk orders of 30 or more TCG cards are $15 each at 20 business days, $20 at 10 or $30 at 5. Sports and non-TCG bulk is $3 more per tier.

faq.q: What costs come on top of the grading fee?
faq.a: Shipping to the grader, return shipping and insurance, and supplies such as penny sleeves and card savers. Some graders add membership fees, subgrade fees or value upcharges. AGS adds return shipping at checkout.
